headline: China's auto production and sales slightly decline in first three quarters; market shows overall 'cold domestically, hot abroad' trend
summary: China's auto production and sales declined slightly in the first three quarters. The market showed weakness domestically while overseas demand was strong.
why: China is the world's largest auto market and producer, so its volumes affect global automakers, suppliers, and commodity demand.
